constraints: If you only use a single representation of the list in the form (or work with structural items rather than the current item), either syntax works; if several representations of the same list exist and the current item ('*' for itemRef) is used, the object-name syntax is required since each representation has its own current item.
If the object name matches several lists in the form (via the '@' wildcard), the command applies to the first one found.

overloadMerges.note: The two doc syntax lines differ only in whether a leading '*' is passed (list as object-name string vs. list reference number). Merged into one semantic overload with that param optional; also added the 0/'*' sentinel values documented for itemRef.
overloadMerges.semanticRole: Get the current character font name of a hierarchical list item, addressed either by list reference number or by the form object name of the list's representation.

params.description: If specified, list is an object name (string); if omitted, list is a hierarchical list reference number.

params.name: list
params.description: Name of list-type object (if '*' passed) or list reference number (if '*' omitted).

sentinelValues.meaning: the last item added to the list
the current item of the list
